rag.text:
Test: TC-2198 — Global - Gadget - Risks - Adding gadget to Jira dashboard
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-162 Global - Gadget
Labels: rocksolid, teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to dashboardName
   Data: dashboardName: TC-2198 Global - Gadget - Risks - Adding gadget to Jira dashboard
   Expected: Jira dashboard page is displayed
2. Click Add gadget button

On Atlassian Cloud first click Edit button to add gadget.
   Expected: Add gadget window appears
3. Click Load all gadgets
   Expected: List of gadgets is visible
4. Search for gadgetName
   Data: gadgetName: BigPicture Risks
   Expected: BigPicture Risks gadget is found
5. Click on Add gadget button
   Expected: Gadget window is visible in the dashboard
6. Close Add gadget window
   Expected: Add gadget window disappears
7. In field Box find boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2198 Global - Gadget - Risks - Adding gadget to Jira dashboard
   Expected: boxName is added to Box field
8. Click on Save button
   Expected: In dashboard appears BigPicture Risks gadget. Gadget has following elements:

Header BigPicture Risks

Risk heat map and risk list is displayed on dashboard.
